registry_disposition.reason: This change works the TOCTOU residual classes of the shared path-confinement primitive as far as the runtime's public API allows: where procfs is available, the confined read is resolved through the pinned, identity-verified base directory descriptor with O_NOFOLLOW on every component (the procfs rooted binding, recorded on the confinement record together with the base directory's own device and inode identity), so a swap anywhere in the traversal can no longer point the read outside the base subtree; the residual R2 is narrowed accordingly and the module header states the narrowed boundary precisely. All existing guards (the regular-file check, the descriptor identity binding, the parent-directory identity re-check and the descriptor-level link-count comparison) are unchanged and still run. On a platform without the binding the previous real-path open and its guards apply unchanged. The residuals R1, R3 and R4 are not claimed as narrowed. The change adds an additive field to a tool surface's record and one shared helper; it alters no contract, no corpus, no record format, no digest, no error-code semantics of the existing vocabulary (one new refusal site reuses PATH_ESCAPES_BASE_THROUGH_SYMLINK for a link introduced in the traversal), no ownership, no lifecycle state, no authority and no dependency. The registration of the change is the new run change registration in the Registry (MAWS_PATH_CONFINEMENT_TOCTOU_2026_10_21_001); the Atlas representation trails it.
